title: Binary Tree Master (Code War Chain)
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n
Line 2: n space-separated integers representing level-order traversal (-1 for null).
outputFormat: A single line output as described by the current stage.

stages.title: Stage 1 - Maximum Depth
stages.statement: Find the maximum depth of the binary tree.

stages.title: Stage 2 - Invert Tree
stages.statement: Invert the binary tree and output the new level-order array representation (trailing nulls ignored).

stages.title: Stage 3 - Symmetric Tree
stages.statement: Return `1` if the tree is a mirror of itself, `0` otherwise.

stages.title: Stage 4 - Diameter
stages.statement: Find the length of the longest path between any two nodes.

stages.title: Stage 5 - Maximum Path Sum
stages.statement: Find the maximum path sum between *any* two nodes (values can be negative).
